query: API contract mismatch inside SageAttention: per_channel_fp8 pads kv_len to 64 but the sm90 kernels require padding to CTA_K=128, so any downstream caller using the memory-efficient direct path (e.g. KJNodes MiniMax H3 patch) aborts when kv_len % 128 is in [65,127].

desired.outcome: Workaround: pad V to a multiple of 128 before per_channel_fp8, exactly as core.py's top-level sageattn_qk_int8_pv_fp8_cuda_sm90 already does (lines ~972-980). OP suggests fixing per_channel_fp8 to pad to 128 or adding a pad_to argument; KJNodes PR #729 filed; nothing merged upstream.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
